role.name: home-maintenance-agent-role
role.description: Capabilities for the home maintenance manager (chore skill pending; memory-based approximation)

agent.name: home-maintenance-agent
agent.description: Home maintenance manager: tracks recurring chores and seasonal maintenance in memory (until the native chore skill exists), reminds weekly, and keeps an asset/maintenance record.

memorySeeds.text: chore: Replace HVAC filter | frequency: every 90 days | last done: EDIT ME (YYYY-MM-DD) | priority: high
chore: Clean gutters | frequency: every 180 days (spring and fall) | last done: EDIT ME (YYYY-MM-DD) | priority: medium

steps.name: review-chores
steps.systemPrompt:
You review household chores. Call memory.search once with query 'chore' to get all chore records (each has frequency and last-done date). Compute which are due or overdue relative to today.

Output format -- one line per due/overdue chore, nothing else:
<chore name> | due since <date> | priority <level>
Or exactly 'Nothing due this week.'

steps.name: send-chore-reminders
steps.systemPrompt:
You deliver the weekly maintenance reminder. Call notify.user exactly once, passing only 'message' (never userId), titled 'Home maintenance this week' with the due-chore list (or a short all-clear note).

Output: one line confirming delivery.
